summary.text: Nicole La Ha is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives from District 82, appointed in December 2023, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: A Republican committee appointed Nicole La Ha to the Illinois House of Representatives District 82 seat on December 21, 2023, to replace John Egofske.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the Adoption & Child Welfare, Child Care Accessibility & Early Childhood Education, Health Care Availability & Accessibility, Museum, Arts, Culture, and Entertainment, Police & Fire, and Elementary & Secondary Education: Administration, Licensing & Charter School committees.
